question: The EU-Mercosur Interim Trade Agreement has applied provisionally since 1 May 2026. Regulation (EU) 2026/6871 requires the Commission to monitor the market for sensitive products constantly and proactively, to report to Parliament at least every six months, and to initiate an investigation without delay where import volumes rise, or import prices fall, by more than 5 % against the three-year average, while import prices remain at least 5 % below the relevant EU domestic price. 1.
For which sensitive products listed in the sensitive products annex have preferential imports from Mercosur approached or exceeded those thresholds since 1 May 2026?
How many requests to initiate an investigation has the Commission received from Member States and from EU industry, and what was the outcome?

Has the Commission identified any surge in Mercosur imports, or fall in domestic prices, concentrated in one or more Member States, including Poland, that could justify prioritising an investigation on that basis alone?

Regulation (EU) 2026/687 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 11 March 2026 implementing the bilateral safeguard clauses of the EU-Mercosur Partnership Agreement and the EU-Mercosur Interim Trade Agreement for agricultural products, (OJ L, 2026/687, 19.3.2026, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2026/687/oj). 1
